hook: I'm leaving my job. **Do I get gratuity?**

slides.title: Does your workplace **qualify?**
slides.body: The gratuity rules cover every shop or establishment with **10 or more employees** on any day in the last 12 months, plus factories, mines, plantations, ports and railway companies.
slides.ref: Code on Social Security 2020 · First Schedule (Chapter V)

slides.title: The **five-year** rule.
slides.body: Gratuity is payable when your job ends after **at least 5 years'** continuous service: on superannuation, retirement, resignation, death or disablement, or end of a fixed-term contract.

slides.title: Five years **not always needed.**
list: Death: paid to nominee or heirs
Disablement due to accident or disease
slides.ref: SS Code 2020 · Sec 53(1) provisos; IR Code 2020 · Sec 2(o)

slides.title: The **formula.**
slides.body: **15 days' wages** at your last drawn rate, for every completed year of service or part over six months. Monthly paid? 15 days' wages = monthly wages ÷ 26 × 15.
slides.ref: Code on Social Security 2020 · Sec 53(2), Explanation 3

slides.title: Quick **example.**
slides.body: Last monthly wages ₹52,000, 10 years' service: 52,000 ÷ 26 × 15 = ₹30,000 per year. × 10 years = **₹3,00,000.**

slides.title: Maximum: **₹20 lakh.**
slides.body: The Code caps gratuity at an amount the Centre notifies, currently ₹20 lakh. Your employer can still give you **better terms.**
slides.ref: SS Code 2020 · Sec 53(3), (5); Labour Ministry FAQs (25.10.2026)

slides.title: Paid within **30 days.**
list: It must be paid within **30 days** of becoming payable.
Paid late? **Simple interest** from the due date.

sources: Code on Social Security, 2020 – Sections 53, 54, 56, 164 and First Schedule (in force from 21 Nov 2025, PIB)
Ministry of Labour & Employment – FAQs on Labour Codes & Central Rules, as on 25.10.2026 (labour.gov.in)
caption:
Leaving your job after years of service? Here's how gratuity works. 👇

1️⃣ Covers shops and establishments with 10+ employees, plus factories, mines, plantations, ports and railway companies
2️⃣ Usually needs 5 years' continuous service; not needed on death or disablement
3️⃣ Fixed-term employees become eligible after 1 year
4️⃣ Formula: 15 days' wages (monthly wages ÷ 26 × 15) for every completed year, or part over six months
5️⃣ Maximum is currently ₹20 lakh, as notified by the Centre
6️⃣ Employer must pay within 30 days of it becoming payable, or pay simple interest
⚠️ The Code on Social Security, 2020 is in force from 21 Nov 2025 and replaced the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972

Source: Code on Social Security, 2020 (Sec 53, 56, First Schedule); Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (Sec 2(o))
